SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl,
fp.nickname AS nickname, fp.introduction AS introduction, fp.github_url AS githubUrl, fp.website_url AS websiteUrl,
fp.school_name AS schoolName, fp.major AS major, fp.degree AS degree, fp.grad_status AS gradStatus,
p.portfolio_id AS portfolioId, p.title AS portfolioTitle, p.portfolio_url AS portfolioUrl, p.file_size AS portfolioFileSize, p.is_public AS portfolioPublic FROM users u LEFT JOIN freelancer_profiles fp ON fp.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pp.* FROM freelancer_portfolios pp WHERE pp.freelancer_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pp.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) p ON p.freelancer_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO freelancer_profiles (user_id, nickname, introduction, github_url, website_url, school_name, major, degree, grad_status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{nickname}, #{introduction}, #{githubUrl}, #{websiteUrl}, #{schoolName}, #{major}, #{degree}, #{gradStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE freelancer_profiles SET nickname = #{nickname}, introduction = #{introduction}, github_url = #{githubUrl}, website_url = #{websiteUrl}, school_name = #{schoolName}, major = #{major}, degree = #{degree}, grad_status = #{gradStatus} WHERE user_id = #{userId}

mapper.update: UPDATE freelancer_portfolios SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, portfolio_url = #{portfolioUrl}, file_size = #{fileSize}, is_public = #{isPublic} WHERE portfolio_id = #{portfolioId}
